description: Look up a cart made with create_cart_order: the cart status and each item with its own status_url. Statuses: pending_payment (waiting for payment; for a phone-number order held for an ID check, payment_url appears once approved and nothing is charged before that), paid, activating (paid and being prepared, delivered within 10 minutes; if it needs more time the note says so and the buyer is emailed, and they can ask for a full refund before delivery), delivered, failed, refunded. Delivered orders carry the eSIM activation details or the proxy lines.
name: get_cart_status
